verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents loading React through a script tag or CDN without npm or a bundler. 'Add React to your existing HTML page' (react-docs-1, react-docs-12) describes incremental adoption, not bundler-free use. The 'no install' claim (react-docs-20) refers to an online sandbox, and the from-scratch guide says to start by installing a build tool (react-docs-22).
